instructions:
## Objective

Build a fast, exact and deterministic DBSCAN implementation for 2D tensors.

## Work to perform

Implement fastcluster.dbscan2d with specified float32 distance semantics, core connectivity and border-point tie rules. Test generated clouds across families and scales. CPU and combined CPU/CUDA variants use the same output contract.

## Deliverable

Installable fastcluster package exposing dbscan2d.

## Evaluation

Correctness-gated throughput with memory penalties, geometric means across workload axes and summed device scores in the combined variant.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
